name: gtemptyns
description: real esbuild 0.27 output (--bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify-whitespace --minify-syntax) of a TypeScript entry whose module requires the entry itself and a types-only module: `(init_index(), __toCommonJS(index_exports)).KIND` reads the bundle's own entry namespace, and `(init_manifest(), __toCommonJS(manifest_exports))` an empty one
